system.description: Beastfolk are sapient peoples whose defining physical qualities are drawn from animals. They may resemble mammals, birds, reptiles, insects, or combinations of several creatures. Choose an animal or related group of animals that informs your character's appearance and traits.

nature.name: Heightened Instincts
nature.text: Choose Low-Light Vision, Keen Hearing, Keen Scent, Heat Perception, Vibration Sense, or a fully defined narrow Sense appropriate to your lineage. Use Senses and Detection above. Within 2 units, creatures and objects cannot remain Hidden from you when that Sense can detect them under its stated conditions. You can follow fresh trails when the Sense can perceive the traces; this does not create traces for a Sense that cannot detect them. Choose one Beastfolk Species Trait.

traits.name: Burrower
traits.text: Gain Burrow 5 through loose soil, sand, snow, or similarly workable material. You cannot burrow through solid stone, worked flooring, or reinforced structures.

traits.name: Climber
traits.text: Gain Climb 10. When a surface can support you, you may remain secured to it without using your hands.

traits.name: Glider
traits.text: You may glide using the Gliding procedure in Combat Encounters: Movement, including normal use of Dash. This Trait does not allow you to gain height or hover.

traits.name: Natural Armament
traits.text: Choose claws, horns, fangs, a tail, mandibles, or another natural weapon. It otherwise counts as a basic one-handed weapon, does not consume Armory or Inventory capacity, and cannot be disarmed, but it uses the chosen anatomy rather than automatically requiring a free hand. Claws normally require the relevant hand or limb; horns or fangs require the head or mouth; a tail requires the tail. The required body part must be available when you attack with it. Its default Range is 1. When choosing the Trait, choose Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing Damage appropriate to its anatomy with the GM. It uses Basic Melee Attack’s normal Damage and Surge option and grants no additional equipment properties or Mounts unless another rule provides them.

traits.name: Prehensile Limb
traits.text: You possess a tail, trunk, secondary arm, or similar limb. It may hold and use one small item that can be used with one hand, other than a weapon or Guard. The item itself occupies equipment capacity normally. The limb does not grant additional Actions.

traits.name: Quadrupedal Frame
traits.text: Increase your Movement to 12 while no more than one of your hands is occupied. You also count as substantially larger when carrying riders, dragging loads, or resisting effects that would knock you down.

traits.name: Shell or Hide
traits.text: Reduce involuntary movement against you by 1 unit. The first time each Adventure an ordinary environmental hazard would cause you Damage, reduce that Damage to 0. This benefit does not apply to Damage with Breach.

traits.name: Swimmer
traits.text: Gain Swim 10. This changes your movement through water; it does not grant underwater breathing.
